name: woobi
description: Woobi - 3D Virtual Fashion Studio & Monorepo by Troyz Solutions

scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android-app && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && copy android-app\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk woobi.apk
